name: video-asset-renamer
description: Windows PowerShell video asset renaming skill and optional always-on watcher for structured production folders.

interface.shortDescription: Safe batch renaming and Windows background watching for video assets
interface.longDescription: Renames supported video files using the containing shot folder and stable alphabetic suffixes. Includes Preview/Apply guidance, a transactional PowerShell module, a single-instance central watcher, optional 1080P suffix migration, and scheduled-task installation scripts.
defaultPrompt: Preview the video files in the folder I specify and show the old and new names.
Explain why a video folder was skipped by the renamer.
Help me install or troubleshoot the optional Windows central watcher.
